nodes.prompt:
TASK: Dispatch exactly ONE fresh ChatGPT Web helper batch containing two disjoint remediation tasks.
DELIVERABLE: Return the complete helper JSON, including each worker's scope_id, browser binding, terminal state, completion_check, and evidence. Do not infer completion from prose.
SCOPE: Do not edit repository files. Invoke ONLY `/Users/indo/code/project/omo-bridge/target/release/delegate_to_chatgpt_web --batch-stdin --json` once. Do not force a browser driver, start any other helper, or close returned scopes.
VERIFY: Helper exits 0, each worker is ready before dispatch, and every terminal result has scoped completion evidence.
STOP WHEN: Report helper JSON or its authoritative capacity/rate-limit/terminal error.

Pass this exact manifest to the helper stdin:
{"tasks":[{"label":"orca-lite-backend-t3-writer-lease","workspace":"/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite","task":"You own only: src-tauri/src/worktree/manager.rs, src-tauri/src/worktree/model.rs, src-tauri/src/worktree/git.rs, src-tauri/src/ipc/worktree.rs, src-tauri/tests/worktree_safety.rs, src-tauri/tests/e2e_agent_workflow.rs. Preserve unrelated dirty frontend work and do not commit. Inspect the uncommitted WriterLeaseRegistry work. Complete Phase 3: canonical worktree has one writer; bad acquisition rejected; release/drop permits reacquisition; active writer blocks deletion; dirty check/removal serialized; default deletion rejects unmerged branch; explicit destructive deletion remains distinct; reject leading-dash branch/base-ref. If terminal lease binding needs non-owned files, state exact blocker; do not edit elsewhere. Add deterministic tests red then green for missing behavior; run targeted Rust tests. Return changed paths, commands/exit codes, test evidence, blocker, completion_check."},{"label":"orca-lite-frontend-t4-ipc","workspace":"/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite","task":"You own only: ui/src/App.tsx, ui/src/components/WorkspaceHeader.tsx, ui/src/components/WorktreeList.tsx, ui/src/lib/tauri.ts, ui/src/lib/tauri.test.ts, ui/src/lib/ipcErrors.ts, ui/src/lib/ipcErrors.test.ts, ui/src/lib/types.ts, ui/src/types.ts. Preserve unrelated dirty backend work and do not commit. Complete current Phase 7.2: UI components have no direct invoke; lib/tauri.ts owns typed wrappers; DTOs are camelCase matching Rust; structured error handling switches on stable error codes, not prose; remove obsolete ui/src/types.ts only when unused; retain split/session behavior. Add tests red then green as required, then run focused tests and type/build. Return paths, commands/exit codes, evidence, completion_check."}]}

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Read-only verify the ORCA Lite backend writer-lease and branch-safety changes.
DELIVERABLE: Exact commands, exit codes, concise output.
SCOPE: Do not edit, invoke Web helpers, commit, or close scopes.
VERIFY: Run in `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite`: `cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test worktree_safety`, `cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test e2e_agent_workflow`, `cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings`, and `git diff --check`.
STOP WHEN: PASS only if all exit 0; otherwise first concrete failure.
